review: Great value for money, much cheaper than the big hotels nearby.
Location is convenient, close to the airport road and the tech park.
Staff at the front desk were friendly and check in was quick.
The room is very small, there was barely space to open my suitcase.
The bed was comfortable and I slept really well.
The walls are thin and I could hear the next room's TV.
Clean, compact room with everything you need for a short business trip.
Breakfast is basic with not many options.
Wifi was fast and free, which is important for work.
The AC was noisy but it cooled the room well.
Room was spotless and the towels were fresh every day.
No room service late at night and the restaurant closes early.
Perfect budget hotel, I stay here every time I visit the city.
Parking is limited and fills up quickly in the evening.
The bathroom is tiny and the shower floods the floor.
Simple and modern design, everything works.
